original: Allagan Tools is a plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that provides the following features:
translated: Allagan Tools 是 FINAL FANTASY XIV 插件，提供下列功能：

original: Provide information about items, monsters, duties and much more
translated: 查詢物品、怪物、任務等豐富資訊

original: You can open various new windows using command shortcuts(the main filter  or from the main window.
translated: 可透過指令捷徑或主視窗開啟各項功能視窗。

original: If you're unsure, right-click on an item or a table row for more options!
translated: 對物品或表格列按右鍵，即可查看更多操作！

original: To learn about the different features, I recommend going to the settings section and reading the information provided by the ? icons.
translated: 想了解各項功能，請前往設定並查看「?」圖示提供的說明。
關閉並開啟主視窗###Close & Open Main Window

original: Allagan Tools is a mult-purpose plugin providing 3 primary features, tracking/displaying your inventory data, helping you plan crafts and providing information about items. There are other features, and they are covered in 'Features'
translated: Allagan Tools 提供三項主要功能：追蹤與顯示庫存、規劃製作，以及查詢物品資訊。其他功能請參閱功能說明。

original: If you've used Teamcraft or Garland Tools, it takes some inspiration from both.
translated: 本插件參考了 Teamcraft 與 Garland Tools 的部分設計。

original: The plugin will do it's best to keep track of your inventories. Some inventories are only cached when they are first accessed. If you aren't seeing your retainer/free company/glamour chest/etc then please be sure to view them first otherwise the plugin will not be able to cache them.
translated: 插件會盡可能追蹤庫存，但部分庫存必須先在遊戲中開啟一次才能記錄。若看不到雇員、部隊倉庫或投影台等資料，請先開啟對應介面。

original: Once the plugin knows about the items, you can create lists to narrow down searches for specific items, help you sort the items and a myriad of other things.
translated: 庫存記錄完成後，可建立清單縮小搜尋範圍、整理物品，並使用其他功能。

original: The plugin has a dedicated crafts window that lets you create lists of items you want to craft. It'll create a plan that breaks each item down into it's individual parts and will tell you what you're missing. It'll tell you where everything you need is and if you are missing anything, it'll direct you to the place to find/buy the missing items.
translated: 製作視窗可建立待製作物品清單，將物品拆解成各項素材，列出缺少的數量、現有素材的位置，以及缺少素材的採集或購買地點。

original: If you've ever used Teamcraft, you should be right at home.
translated: 如果使用過 Teamcraft，應該很快就能上手。

original: The plugin has a fairly comprehensive database of information about each item. If you've used garland tools, the information provided is very similar. Clicking on an item's icon within the plugin will always open the item's information window.
translated: 插件提供完整的物品資料，內容與 Garland Tools 類似。在插件中點擊物品圖示即可開啟詳細資訊視窗。

original: When using either an item list or a craft list, you can toggle highlighting. This will highlight the items in game so that you can see exactly where the items are. When the plugins windows are active, you can hit the 'Highlight' checkbox to activate highlighting for that list. If you want to trigger this with a macro, please have a look at the commands section of help, you can toggle 'background' highlighting.
translated: 物品清單與製作清單皆可啟用醒目標示，在遊戲庫存中標出物品位置。視窗開啟時勾選「標示」即可啟用；若要使用巨集切換背景標示，請參閱指令說明。

original: This is a very basic guide, for more information please see the wiki.
translated: 此處提供基本操作說明，更多資訊請參閱 Wiki。

original: Lists are the core way the plugin provides a way for you to view the items you are looking for or are attempting to sort.
translated: 清單是查看、搜尋與整理物品的主要方式。

original: There are currently 3 types of list that can be created.
translated: 目前可建立三種類型的清單。

original: This type of list allows you search for specific items across all your inventories. If you just need to find an item, but don't want help sorting it, this is the list type you want.
translated: 此類清單可搜尋所有庫存中的特定物品。若只需要找物品而不需要整理，請使用此類型。

original: Finding a housing item you put somewhere.
translated: 尋找存放在某處的家具。

original: Seeing how much an item you just picked up is worth.
translated: 查看剛取得物品的價值。

original: Seeing if a specific item is already in your glamour chest or armoire.
translated: 確認投影台或收藏櫃是否已存有特定物品。

original: Checking your retainers equipment without actually going to a retainer bell.
translated: 不必前往傳喚鈴即可查看雇員裝備。

original: Checking if any items you have can go into the armoire.
translated: 檢查持有的物品是否可存入收藏櫃。

original: This type of list builds on top of the 'Search List' but also lets you pick where you want the items to be sorted. It'll attempt to show you the most optimized plan for storing the items in the destinations you pick.
translated: 此類清單在搜尋清單的基礎上，可指定物品要收納的位置，並提供合適的整理方案。

original: Putting away materials after a craft and not having them double up.
translated: 製作後收納素材，避免分散重複堆疊。

original: Store items above a certain item level within your chocobo saddlebag for later.
translated: 將指定物品等級以上的物品存放於陸行鳥鞍囊備用。

original: Find items that are unique to your free company chest and put them there.
translated: 找出部隊倉庫特有的物品，並集中收納至該處。

original: This filter allows you search across all the items that exist within the game's catalogue of items.
translated: 此篩選可搜尋遊戲物品圖鑑中的所有物品。

original: Seeing what mounts/minions you haven't obtained
translated: 查看尚未取得的坐騎／寵物

original: Tracking the prices of all the items within the game
translated: 追蹤遊戲內物品的價格

original: When creating a list or when searching through the results of a list it is possible to use a series of operators to make your search more specific. The available operators are dependant on what you searching against but at present support for !, <, >, >=, <=, = is present.
translated: 建立清單或搜尋清單結果時，可使用運算子精確篩選。可用語法依欄位類型而異，目前支援 !、<、>、>=、<=、=。

original: ! - Show any results that do not contain what is entered - available for text and numbers.
translated: !－排除包含輸入內容的結果，適用於文字與數字。

original: < - Show any results that have a value less than what is entered - available for numbers.
translated: <－顯示小於輸入值的結果，適用於數字。

original: > - Show any results that have a value greater than what is entered - available for numbers.
translated: >－顯示大於輸入值的結果，適用於數字。

original: >= - Show any results that have a value greater or equal to what is entered - available for numbers.
translated: >=－顯示大於或等於輸入值的結果，適用於數字。

original: <= - Show any results that have a value less than or equal to what is entered - available for numbers.
translated: <=－顯示小於或等於輸入值的結果，適用於數字。

original: = - Show any results that have a value equal to exactly what is entered - available for text and numbers.
translated: =－顯示完全等於輸入內容的結果，適用於文字與數字。

original: && and || AND and OR respectively - Can be used to chain operators together.
translated: && 與 || 分別代表「且」與「或」，可串接多個篩選條件。

original: This plugin is written in some of the free time that I have, it's a labour of love and I will hopefully be actively releasing updates for a while.
translated: 原作者利用業餘時間開發此插件，並希望持續提供更新。

original: If you run into any issues please submit feedback via the plugin installer feedback button.
translated: 如遇問題，請透過插件安裝器的意見回饋按鈕回報。

original: Match against the currently logged in character.
When 'All' or 'World' is selected, choose the types of characters you want to filter against. Select an item again to unselect it.

translated: 勾選後，改為搜尋所選條件以外的結果。

original: How should the item be sourced? As there are multiple ways to source an item, you can either rely on your list's ingredient sourcing (tab inside the craft list's settings) or you can override the source here.
translated: 設定物品的取得方式。可沿用製作清單設定中的素材來源偏好，或在此個別指定。

original: Override the price for this item. This is only used when no pricing is available. Use this to give you a rough estimate of the gil cost of your item.
translated: 設定此物品的備用估價。僅在無法取得價格時使用，以估算金幣成本。

original: Override the market world preferences for this item. If you select a world here, the craft pricer will attempt to take prices from this world first then follow the normal rules for craft pricing.
translated: 個別設定市場伺服器偏好。估價時會先查詢此處指定的伺服器，再依一般估價規則處理。

original: Where should the item be sourced from? As there are sometimes multiple locations to source an item from, you can either rely on your list's zone preferences (tab inside the craft list's settings) or you can override the zone here.
translated: 設定物品的取得區域。可沿用製作清單設定中的區域偏好，或在此個別指定。

original: Should we source the item from your retainers? If there is a quantity available of the correct quality it will show up in the Items in Retainers/Bags section.
translated: 是否從雇員取得物品？若雇員持有符合品質的物品，會顯示於雇員／背包物品區段。

original: Should the item be HQ or NQ? For output items, the quantity needed will only reduce if you craft an item of the correct quality. For other materials this will dictate what is listed to retrieve and what counts towards the amount you need.
translated: 設定 HQ 或 NQ 需求。成品只有在製作出符合品質的物品時才會扣除需求；素材則依此決定取物清單與可計入的庫存。

original: Select which recipe you wish to use for this item. Some items can be crafted by multiple classes.
translated: 選擇此物品要使用的配方。部分物品可由不同職業製作。
